description: Scenarios for scripts/perf/perf.py. Flags and grids are those of scripts/phase2-baseline.ps1 and scripts/phase2-profile.ps1; the harness adds the benchmark, profile and acceptance flags itself.

synthetic.description: 250,000 synthetic instances; needs no converted data

terrain-water.description: terrain and water fixture scene; needs no converted data

dense.description: Riverwood, Tamriel grid 3,-12 standing still (about 2,900 references within two cells)

dense-legacy.description: the former dense place, Tamriel grid 18,-5 (about 1,530 references)

stress.description: streaming stress: stream radius 3, flying at 5000 units per second from grid 0,0

stress-still.description: the stress scene's stream radius 3, standing still at grid 0,0

stability.description: soak: Riverwood flying at 900 units per second, 30 minutes unless --duration says otherwise

travel.description: the frame-time route (scripts/routes/travel.json); the window is at least the route's travel time plus 60 s

check.description: the held-out route (scripts/routes/check.json): report it, never tune against it
